name: FreshBooks
label: FreshBooks — FreshBooks REST (accounting/account/{accountid})
description: Official FreshBooks REST (accounting/account/{accountid}). Docs: https://www.freshbooks.com/api/start. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. OAuth 2 at auth.freshbooks.com. Payments record amounts — no PAN.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for FreshBooks. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: client_create | invoice_create | invoice_get | invoice_list | payment_create | expense_create | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: client
schema.description: Client envelope escape hatch for client_create. Purpose fields email/fname/lname/organization merge into client via bodyMap. Example: {"p_city":"Toronto"}.

schema.label: invoice
schema.description: Invoice envelope escape hatch for invoice_create. Purpose fields customerid/create_date/currency_code/lines merge in via bodyMap. Example: {"notes":"Net 30"}.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operation: invoice_list.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `per_page` for operation: invoice_list.

schema.label: payment
schema.description: Payment envelope escape hatch for payment_create. Purpose fields invoiceid/amount/date/type merge in via bodyMap. Example: {"note":"Check 1042"}.

schema.label: expense
schema.description: Expense envelope escape hatch for expense_create. Purpose fields amount/categoryid/staffid/date merge in via bodyMap. Example: {"vendor":"Staples"}.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Client email on client_create. Nested as client.email. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: fname
schema.description: Client first name on client_create. Nested as client.fname. Example: Ada.

schema.label: lname
schema.description: Client last name on client_create. Nested as client.lname. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: organization
schema.description: Client organization on client_create. Nested as client.organization. Example: Analytical Engines.

schema.label: customerid
schema.description: Invoice customer id on invoice_create (required). Nested as invoice.customerid. Example: 123.

schema.label: create_date
schema.description: Invoice date YYYY-MM-DD on invoice_create (required). Nested as invoice.create_date. Example: 2026-11-01.

schema.label: currency_code
schema.description: Invoice ISO-4217 currency on invoice_create. Nested as invoice.currency_code. Example: USD.

schema.label: lines
schema.description: Invoice line items on invoice_create. Nested as invoice.lines. Example: [{"name":"Hours","qty":1,"unit_cost":{"amount":"100.00","code":"USD"}}].

schema.label: invoiceid
schema.description: Invoice id on payment_create. Nested as payment.invoiceid. Example: 456.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Money object {amount, code} on payment_create (payment.amount) and expense_create (expense.amount). Example: {"amount":"39.99","code":"USD"}.

schema.label: date
schema.description: YYYY-MM-DD on payment_create (payment.date) and expense_create (expense.date). Example: 2026-11-01.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Payment type on payment_create. Nested as payment.type. EXACT common: Check | Credit | Cash | Bank Transfer | PayPal | Credit Card. Example: Check.

schema.label: categoryid
schema.description: Expense category id on expense_create (required). Nested as expense.categoryid. Example: 1.

schema.label: staffid
schema.description: Expense staff id on expense_create (required). Nested as expense.staffid. Example: 1.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: Http Status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: client_create | invoice_create | invoice_get | invoice_list | payment_create | expense_create | trigger. Default client_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: FreshBooks credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
